name: Path Solver
description: Auto-solves a level into a clean, low-click macro and shows a live progress map.

sim-budget-ms.name: Solver time per frame (ms)
sim-budget-ms.description: How many milliseconds of every frame the solver may spend simulating. Higher = faster solving, choppier map.

checkpoint-interval.name: Checkpoint spacing (ticks)
checkpoint-interval.description: Ticks (1/240 s) between solver checkpoints. Lower = faster retries but more memory on trigger-heavy levels.

min-press-ticks.name: Shortest click (ticks)
min-press-ticks.description: No hold in the macro will be shorter than this. 6 ticks = 25 ms.

min-gap-ticks.name: Shortest gap between clicks (ticks)
min-gap-ticks.description: Two clicks closer together than this are merged into one hold.

prune-clicks.name: Remove extra clicks
prune-clicks.description: After a solution is found, try deleting and merging every click and keep each change that still beats the level.

seed.name: Random seed
seed.description: Same seed + same level = same macro.

export-frame-offset.name: Export frame offset
export-frame-offset.description: Added to every frame in the saved .gdr.json. Only change this if the macro is off by a frame in another bot.
